Pulsed Laser Ablation
nodes.procedure: Polycrystalline copper(I) oxide (Cu2O) nanoparticles were prepared through the pulsed laser ablation technique. This strategy generates grain boundaries within the Cu2O particles.
nodes.source_text: Initially, polycrystalline copper (I) oxide (Cu2O) nanoparticles were prepared through the pulsed laser ablation technique. This strategy generates grain boundaries within the Cu2O particles.

nodes.name: Electroreduction
nodes.procedure: The Cu2O nanoparticles undergo electroreduction to yield pure Cu with distorted nanotwins (DNTs) and edge dislocations.
nodes.source_text: In the consequent step, the Cu2O nanoparticles undergo electroreduction to yield pure Cu.

nodes.name: Topochemical Phosphidation
nodes.procedure: Two-dimensional transition metal phosphides (2D TMPs), such as Co2P, Ni12P5, and CoxFe2-xP were produced in solution, utilizing 2D phosphorene sheets as both the phosphorus (P) source and sacrificial template.
nodes.source_text: Feng co-workers reported a topochemical strategy for producing two-dimensional transition metal phosphides (2D TMPs)... utilizing 2D phosphorene sheets as both the phosphorus (P) source and sacrificial template.

nodes.name: Two-Step Electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: By employing a simple, two-step electrodeposition technique, porous structured three-dimensional (3D) FeP, CoP, NiP, and CuP nanosheets on NiO electrode.
nodes.source_text: By employing a simple, two-step electrodeposition technique, Marimuthu et al. prepared a porous structured three-dimensional (3D) FeP, CoP, NiP, and CuP nanosheets on NiO electrode.

nodes.name: Hetero-interface Modification
nodes.procedure: Successfully established a method for effectively modifying the electrical structure at the hetero-interface to customize and stabilize the bifunctional OER/HER active sites of 3D bimetallic FeCoP nanosheets.
nodes.source_text: The same research group successfully further established a method for effectively modifying the electrical structure at the hetero-interface... of 3D bimetallic FeCoP nanosheets.

nodes.name: Ni(OH)2 Binding Manipulation
nodes.procedure: Through active binding manipulation of Ni(OH)2 and FeCoP, the current strategy seeks to modify the electronic structure and steady the hetero-interface.
nodes.source_text: Through active binding manipulation of Ni(OH)2 and FeCoP, the current strategy seeks to modify the electronic structure and steady the hetero-interface.
